hook: Throat feeling scratchy and raw? Grandma always reached for the same two things from the kitchen.
remedy: As a bit of old-fashioned home wisdom, warm honey and lemon has been a go-to comfort drink for a scratchy throat for generations — the warmth and honey's soothing texture can make swallowing feel a lot more comfortable.
steps: Squeeze half a lemon into a mug of warm (not boiling) water
Stir in a tablespoon of honey until dissolved
Sip slowly while it's still warm
caution: Never give honey to a baby under 1 year old — it carries a small risk of infant botulism.
cta: Follow along for more old-school home remedies
